After you approve, we remove the ones you no longer need and clean up the leftover code.

faq: How do you know an app is unused?
We check how often it appears in your pages, its settings, what it stores and when it last did anything. If we are unsure, we ask you before taking any step.
Will removing an app delete my data?
Some apps keep data such as reviews or wishlists. We export it first and tell you what will be lost, so you can decide before anything is removed.
Can you save me money on monthly fees?
Often yes, as unused paid apps add up. We show each cost, and you decide which to cancel. We do not cancel subscriptions on your behalf without your approval.
Do you work with WordPress plugins too?
Yes. The same steps apply to WooCommerce and WordPress sites, where plugins can slow the site and leave a security risk when they are not updated.
